provenance.psf_model: pixel-integrated circular Gaussian, FWHM from PSF_FWHM header (EPSF not used)

variability_indicator.method: visit scale factors on a shared ln(lambda) polynomial (degree 2)
variability_indicator.reason: visits cover different wavelengths; the shared spectrum is extrapolated
variability_indicator.release_note: Visits come from DR1, QR3. IRSA documents DR1 and QR3 as one uniformly processed set.
variability_indicator.warning: Apparent variability can be instrumental: different wavelengths, detector positions, PSF/undersampling phase, background and calibration between visits. Treat it as a candidate until repeated in another channel or instrument.

sources.label: known high-proper-motion object
sources.note: Motion agrees with Gaia DR3 6412596012146801152 (0.71 sigma): known high-proper-motion object.

light_curve.warning: Each point is at a different wavelength (colour = wavelength). Changes in flux between points reflect the spectrum as well as time; use variability_indicator.

limitations: PSF-fitted flux assuming a Gaussian PSF: absolute level uncertain by ~10%, colours across one detector better.
Points from different visits are combined in 'combined'; a variable source blurs it (see 'visits').
Saturated or masked cores are excluded, so bright stars can have no spectrum at all.
